{{Short description|French physicist and mathematician}}
'''Jean Pigeon d'Osangis''' (born 1654, [[Donzy]], [[Nivernais]]; died 1739) was a French physicist and mathematician, noted for the construction of [[planisphere]]s.<ref name="Diderot1999">{{cite book|author=Denis Diderot|title=Jacques the Fatalist and His Master|url=https://archive.org/details/jacquesfatalisth00dide|url-access=registration|year=1999|publisher=Oxford University Press|isbn=978-0-19-283874-2|pages=[https://archive.org/details/jacquesfatalisth00dide/page/245 245]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://catalogue.museogalileo.it/biography/JeanPigeon.html|title=Jean Pigeon|website=[[Museo Galileo]]|access-date=2018-12-13}}</ref>

He was also a globe maker.<ref name=bibnum>{{cite web |url= https://bibnum.explore.psl.eu/s/dictionarypim/ark:/18469/1qjqm|title= Pigeon d'Onsangis, Jean|last1=Beaudouin |first1= Denis|last2= Brenni|first2=Paolo|last3=Turner|first3=Anthony|website= Dictionary of precision Instrument-makers and related craftsmen|publisher= Paris Sciences & Lettres (PSL)|access-date= 31 March 2024}}</ref> In the [[University of Wrocław]]'s map collection, there survives one of only two remaining examples of a 7-cm terrestrial pocket globe that Pigeon published in 1717.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Szykuła|first=Krystyna|title=Remarkable Globes in the Wrocław (Breslau) University Library's Map Collection|date=2005|journal=Globe Studies|issue=51/52|pages=103–108|jstor=23993599}}</ref>

He was the father of [[Marie Anne Victoire Pigeon]].

He was a member of the Paris Society of Arts.<ref name="Strickland2018">{{cite book|author=Lloyd Strickland|author-link=Lloyd Strickland|title=The Philosophical Writings of Prémontval|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=fqJRDwAAQBAJ&pg=PR15|date=28 March 2018|publisher=Lexington Books|isbn=978-1-4985-6357-4|page=15}}</ref><ref name="Bertucci2017">{{cite book|author=Paola Bertucci|title=Artisanal Enlightenment: Science and the Mechanical Arts in Old Regime France|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Yq88DwAAQBAJ&pg=PA105|year=2017|publisher=Yale University Press|isbn=978-0-300-22741-3|page=105}}</ref>
